data.name: Maruti
data.gender_notes: Maruti is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Maruti is a name derived from the Hindu god Hanuman, who is also known as Maruti. The name signifies the god as the lord of the winds, as he is believed to be the swift messenger of Lord Rama. Maruti is also considered the god of knowledge and wisdom. The name Maruti carries the meaning “Lord of the Winds” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Maruti usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the winds and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Maruti belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the Winds.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Maruti total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
